layers.deterministic: Style gate, Claudespeak/slop tell counters, arithmetic recomputation, citation URL hygiene, exact contradiction string pairs when provided
layers.typed_judge_jev: Narrow noul/choice/score questions over checklist items once criteria are crisp (promise present?, number grounded?, MECE applicable?)
layers.llm_as_judge: Open criteria needing short evidence quotes + repair direction; instance-specific checklists; adjudication when lenses conflict
layers.human: Gold labels for seed set; periodic judge calibration

scoring_philosophy.recommendation: Hybrid. Prefer deterministic + binary checklists first; Jev for high-volume typed gates; LLM-as-judge for sparse open defects with required quote anchors. Do not rely on freeform 1-5 professionalism scores alone.

dimensions.label: Promise / commitment fidelity
dimensions.what: Unauthorized, unconditional, or fabricated guarantees, dates, savings, scope, staffing, SLAs, and implied CTA promises (esp. SOW / proposal).
must_fail_examples: Guarantees outcome without approved authority or conditions
Invented delivery date, % savings, or headcount not in brief/source pack
Headline/CTA implies a commitment the body does not authorize

dimensions.label: Evidence grounding
dimensions.what: Material claims must be entailed by the supplied brief, cited source, or marked as assumption. Citation ≠ support.
must_fail_examples: Cites a real URL that does not entail the number or causal claim
Vague authority (industry experts agree) with no source
Confidential claim verified via web when packet forbids it

dimensions.label: Numbers integrity
dimensions.what: Arithmetic, units, baselines, forecast vs actual, prose/table agreement.
must_fail_examples: Totals that do not sum
Schedule weeks that contradict stated dates
Percent without denominator or baseline

dimensions.label: Internal consistency
dimensions.what: Contradictions across slides/sections/tables; summary that overstates body; recommendation that does not follow stated criteria.
must_fail_examples: Reversible migration while legacy DB is deleted
Launch date before required security review completes

dimensions.label: Decision readiness
dimensions.what: For the stated audience decision: missing owner, criteria, risks, next step, unresolved dependency, or monitoring measure.
must_fail_examples: Recommend launch with Legal still pending and no decision gate
Monitor success with no metric, owner, or threshold

dimensions.label: Language precision
dimensions.what: Ambiguity that changes obligation, authority, scope, or confidence (will/should/may; hidden actors; undefined terms).
must_fail_examples: We will deliver X when only a pilot is authorized
Passive voice hiding who pays or owns risk on a material point

dimensions.label: Anti-slop / Claudespeak
dimensions.what: AI-writing residue and consulting-register LLM-ese that reduces professionalism without adding information.
must_fail_examples: Dense robust/next-generation/unlock/landscape filler on a CFO decision slide
Here's what nobody tells you teasers with no payload
Opus-class Claudespeak that would fail a partner edit

dimensions.label: MECE accountability (when applicable)
dimensions.what: Overlapping owners, gaps, unclear handoffs for assigned responsibilities. N/A when doc does not assign roles.
must_fail_examples: Two owners of same scoped decision without boundary
Transition to support with contributors but no accountable owner

task_schema.brief_or_source_pack: paths or inline facts (trap facts allowed)

checklist.statement: Binary pass/fail criterion with expected answer

seed_task_ideas.sketch: SOW invents 40% cost reduction and wrong subscription total vs brief
6-slide AI strategy deck heavy on Claudespeak; partner-grade rewrite is gold
Executive readout cites real McKinsey URL that does not support the claimed CAGR
Launch date before security review; Legal pending; monitor with no thresholds
